topic: Top 3 strongest nations in the world

lines.text: Welcome to the ultimate showdown of the world's mightiest militaries.
lines.search_term: global map highlighting military power ranking

lines.text: At number three we find Russia. It fields over a million active soldiers and a vast arsenal of tanks and missiles.
Russia's modernized S400 air defense and its recent actions in Ukraine keep its combat reputation fierce.
Sliding into second place is China, boasting the world's largest standing army and a rapidly expanding navy.
China's fifth generation J20 stealth fighters and its carrier based operations showcase cutting edge technology.
lines.search_term: J20 stealth fighter carrier deck China

lines.text: Recent drills in the South China Sea demonstrate its ability to project power across contested waters.
lines.search_term: Chinese navy drills South China Sea 2026

lines.text: Holding the top spot is the United States. It has a global reach of over 800,000 active troops and a fleet of 11 aircraft carriers.
lines.search_term: US Navy aircraft carriers at sea 2026

lines.text: American F35 jets, nuclear submarines, and its massive defense budget ensure unmatched technological superiority.
Together, these three powers shape global security, and their next moves will decide the future of warfare.
